title: Mushrooms Reforged
description: Fully redesigned mushrooms with custom models and new item sprites!
body:
**Ever thought that the vanilla mushrooms looked just a bit too boring and flat? Well this pack aims to fix this by completely redesigning their item sprites and giving them custom models when placed!**

![Image](https://i.gyazo.com/49488b3a21a8e9fc52ca183b6ef94ca0.png)
![Image](https://i.gyazo.com/a87ce425ac4f43f6e3ec24ca5de435c2.png)
![Image](https://i.gyazo.com/20083c2bc2fc6ac76651707e45949ae0.png)
![Image](https://i.gyazo.com/f3e8e604382bafed197d20a808bbea7e.png)

**The contents of this mini pack are from a greater project I'm working on called [Rappenem's Reforge](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/rappenems-reforge) which aims to resprite the whole game in this style. So if you like the pixel art on display here consider checking it out and supporting me on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/Rappenem) for access to the dev version, exclusive content and more!**
